cases.name: Camille Karen Foss
cases.about: She was a head cashier at the Sears Roebuck & Co. store in Washington Square Mall.
cases.narrative: She left work to take a deposit to the bank. Camille never made it to the bank because she was shot in the Washington Square parking lot. State medical examiner, Dr. William Brady, said she was shot twice, one bullet grazing a thumb before hitting her in the neck and the other bullet striking her in the chest. Dr. Brady said she also had been beaten in the face. Detectives said nothing appeared to be missing from the scene, including the bank deposit. Law enforcement said that she showed no signs of being sexually assaulted.

cases.narrative: He was driving on Cornell Rd. in Hillsboro when he spotted her driving a green Volkswagen Beetle as she was returning home from work. He forcibly dragged her into his car drove for approximately a third of a mile before he shot her in the head. Barone then left her body in the middle of the road on Northeast 231st Ave., where she was discovered by a passing motorist.
